pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/verify/visual/route.ts:175 The route asks a model judge (via the vision router) for a pass/fail verdict on a screenshot and saves it to visual_verifications with only verdict/anyEmpty/elements/notes; the provider, model, effort and prompt version are returned in the response but never stored (the table schema has no column for them), so stored verdicts cannot be tied to the judge that produced them and a silent re-route breaks the series.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/verify/visual/route.ts:175 The judge is not pinned (the router picks the eye at call time) and the stored verdict carries no model or packet version; provenance only appears in the HTTP response at line 206.

src/app/api/verify/visual/route.ts:169 The judge's output must be structured JSON, and the verdict shape is checked mechanically before it is stored. Nothing cross-checks verdict=pass against anyEmpty=true, though.
